description: §15.10.1 (S459 L1) — a REST parameter binds its name: `function g(...n)` inside a component with a prop `n` shadows the prop in the body (`n.length` is 3), the prop still reads 4 outside `g`, and a top-level `function top(...xs)` sees `xs`. Before S459 the type system bound the literal parameter text `"... n"`, so the body's `n` / `xs` was E-SCOPE-001 — inside and outside components.
rationale: §15.10.1: a parameter shadows a same-named prop in its function body. The scope check reads parameter names through the same binder rule as component prop substitution (binding-names.ts).
